name.value: Poco Inn and Suites Hotel & Conference Centre

description.value: The Poco Inn & Suites is a 99-room full-service hotel in Port Coquitlam, situated about 30 minutes from downtown Vancouver and minutes from two SkyTrain stations. The property spans two wings offering a range of room types including kitchen suites and themed rooms, plus a fitness centre with sauna, on-site restaurant, lounge, and conference facilities. It sits near five golf courses, shopping, and dining, and has hosted at least one organized cycling fundraiser group (Tour de Fox Pacific Northwest).

raw_osm.name: Poco Inn and Suites Hotel & Conference Centre

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and fully functional, confirming the hotel at 1545 Lougheed Highway, Port Coquitlam, with phone 604.941.6216 found on the Directions page. The site explicitly states 'high speed wired and Wi-Fi in every room' and describes a 'full service dining restaurant' and 'intimate lounge,' confirming Wi-Fi and on-site evening food. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, though a testimonial from the Tour de Fox Pacific Northwest cycling fundraiser group notes a stay here, suggesting cyclists do use the property.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; phone 604.941.6216 was sourced from the website Directions page only.
OSM name includes '& Conference Centre' while the website most prominently uses 'Poco Inn & Suites Hotel' without that suffix; the Directions page does use the full name, so not a clear discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel with an active website and confirmed address. Has hosted organized cycling groups and provides standard hotel services useful to touring cyclists.

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site full service dining restaurant and intimate lounge mentioned on hotel overview page
